trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: Customer states their intent to track an order and volunteers extra context as an anxious first-timer.
steps.text: नमस्कार, मला माझी order track करायची आहे. मला ती आजच हवी आहे. मी marathon साठी shoes order केले आहेत, माझी पहिलीच वेळ आहे.

steps.purpose: Agent greets the customer and asks for the order ID.
steps.text: नमस्कार, मी नक्की मदत करतो. कृपया तुमचा order ID सांगू शकता का?

steps.purpose: Customer provides the order ID, with a phonetic substitution STT error.
steps.text: हो, माझा border ID ORD-30003 आहे.

steps.purpose: Agent acknowledges the ID and asks for verification factors.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. Verification साठी तुमचं registered name आणि pin code सांगू शकता का?

steps.purpose: Customer provides verification details.
steps.text: माझं नाव Rohan आहे आणि pin code 411001 आहे.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity before accessing order details.
Return the verification outcome.
Agent thanks the customer and states intent to check the order, using natural verb construction.
steps.text: Details verify केल्याबद्दल धन्यवाद. मी तुमची order system मध्ये check करतो.

steps.purpose: Look up the order details.
Return the order details.
Agent grounds response in the tool output, stating exact item, status, and days.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent states the exact status and days from the tool result without unauthorized guarantees.
steps.text: तुमची running shoes ची order 'out for delivery' आहे. तुम्ही order करून 2 दिवस झाले आहेत आणि promised delivery 4 दिवसांची आहे.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must ground its response entirely on the lookup_order tool result, stating the item, status, and days without making unsupported promises.

steps.purpose: Customer restates figures to confirm understanding and asks if they will get it today.
steps.text: म्हणजे 2 दिवस झालेत आणि 4 दिवसांची promise होती, बरोबर? पण मला आजच मिळेल का?

steps.purpose: Agent states intent to track the shipment exactly, using natural verb construction.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent naturally blends English nouns with native verbs when explaining the next step.
steps.text: मी courier चं exact status track करतो, एक मिनिट द्या.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent uses the natural construction 'track करतो' instead of a formal or literal translation.

steps.purpose: Track the shipment to get courier scan truth.
Return the shipment tracking details.
Agent describes the delivery status strictly from the courier scan.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent relays the courier name, last scan, and exception status exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: BlueDart courier कडे तुमची order आहे आणि त्यावर 'out for delivery' चा last scan आहे. कोणतीही exception किंवा delay नाहीये.
steps.planner_rationale: Grounding the response in the track_shipment result ensures adherence to the scan truth business rule.

steps.purpose: Customer asks a clarifying question about raising a complaint if it doesn't arrive today.
steps.text: अच्छा. जर मला आज order नाही मिळाली, तर मी complaint raise करू शकतो का?

steps.purpose: Agent enforces the complaint window rule using a natural verb construction.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent refuses to raise a complaint before the window elapses and explains the policy naturally.
steps.text: आपल्या policy नुसार, promised 4 दिवस पूर्ण झाल्यावरच complaint raise करता येते. आज फक्त 2 दिवस झाले आहेत, त्यामुळे आत्ता complaint raise करता येणार नाही.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must enforce the business rule that a complaint cannot be raised before the promised window elapses, using a natural verb construction.

steps.purpose: Customer hesitates and restates the prepaid amount, seeking reassurance.
steps.text: असं का... मी थोडा confused आहे. मी 3299 rupees चं prepaid payment केलं आहे. माझे पैसे तर सुरक्षित आहेत ना?

steps.purpose: Agent reassures the customer by grounding the response in the tool's amount and status fields without making forward guarantees.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent confirms the prepaid amount is safe based on the out_for_delivery status, without promising it will arrive today.
steps.text: हो, तुमचे 3299 rupees पूर्णपणे सुरक्षित आहेत. Order 'out for delivery' आहे, त्यामुळे delivery ची process चालू आहे.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent reassures the anxious customer by grounding the response in the tool's amount and status fields, explicitly avoiding any forward guarantee of delivery time.

steps.purpose: Customer agrees to wait and asks if anything else is needed.
steps.text: ठीक आहे, मी wait करतो. मला अजून काही करायची गरज आहे का?

steps.purpose: Agent confirms no further action is needed.
steps.text: नाही, तुम्हाला काहीच करायची गरज नाही. अजून काही माहिती हवी आहे का?

steps.purpose: Customer declines further help.
steps.text: नाही, एवढंच विचारायचं होतं. Thank you.

steps.purpose: Agent closes the call.
steps.text: Call केल्याबद्दल धन्यवाद. तुमचा दिवस शुभ जावो.

ir.terminal_condition: Customer told exactly where the shipment is and what happens next.

verification.summary: The conversation is an excellent training example. It perfectly captures the anxious first-timer persona, with the user volunteering context, restating figures, and seeking reassurance. The agent strictly adheres to business policies by grounding responses in tool outputs and refusing to promise a delivery date or raise a premature complaint. The Marathi-English code-switching is natural and adheres to the requested script mode. The STT error ('border ID') is also a highly plausible phonetic mistake.
